prerequisites: Root receives pushed exact BossFang migration commit and explicit dispatch authorization.
Root commits/pushes The Boss build/integration-sources.json with sources.bossfang.revision exact migration SHA and tools.bossfang.version matching its Cargo package.
Root reads the remote ref build/integration-sources.json and confirms the source pin before dispatch; head acknowledgement records the actual producer Boss commit.
Record dispatch intent before external effect. Recover matching observed run if acknowledgement is lost; never blindly redispatch.

contract.nativeSource: scripts/integration-source.cjs consumes INTEGRATION_TOOLS=bossfang and exact committed source pins.
contract.nativeBuild: scripts/build-integration-tools.cjs receives native target and INTEGRATION_TOOLS=bossfang; produces only selected BossFang binaries/dashboard closure.
contract.otherTools: No unrelated native tools rebuilt. Existing package records retain their actual sources.
contract.imagesAndPublication: native_artifacts_only=true skips service images and publish; root later reuses the successful artifacts for a small new immutable payload tag.
contract.cache: native-<platform>-<hash(build/integration-sources.json)> with native-<platform>- restore prefix; earlier two-platform producer supplies warm cache.
contract.handles: gh workflow run returns run URL. Record actual run ID, head_sha and Native tools (<platform>) job IDs, then artifacts native-tools-<platform>. Do not infer build or release success from dispatch.

limitations: No dispatch, builds, native binary operation, publication, code edits or ledger mutation performed.
Repair commit and new producer head remain pending.
